h1: Get your MCP server into the Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini stores
lead: Each store checks different things: OAuth, tool annotations, descriptions, error handling, policy text. We find what blocks you, fix it, and submit. Fixed prices, paid by card.

services.name: Readiness Audit
services.short: Find out what stops your server from being listed, in order of what blocks you first.
services.price_note: Fixed price. Report in 3 business days.
scope: We run McpStamp Check on your endpoint, then read the server by hand.
OAuth flow, tool annotations, tool descriptions and error handling.
Store policies for the Claude Directory, ChatGPT Apps, Gemini Connected Apps and the MCP Registry.
you_get: A written fix list, ranked by store blocker
A code snippet for each fix
A 30-minute call to go through it

services.name: Store Launch
services.short: We fix your server so it passes, then list it in four places.
services.price_note: Fixed price. About 10 business days. $1,500 deposit now, the rest at handover.
scope: We fix your server until it passes McpStamp Check and each store's review list.
OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, PKCE and refresh tokens.
Tool annotations, server instructions and clear tool descriptions.
We prepare and submit the listings to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and the MCP Registry.
you_get: Fixes as commits in your repository
Answers to reviewer questions while the job runs
services.note: Google opened Connected Apps for Gemini in preview on 28 Oct 2026. Few apps are listed so far.

services.name: Custom MCP server
services.short: No server yet? We build one on your API, spreadsheet or docs.
services.price_note: Fixed quote first. $900 deposit books the work.
scope: Wrap your API. The model gets typed tools with clear names, and your keys stay in your config.
Put a spreadsheet or CSV behind tools that read it, check it and write back only the rows you allow.
Make internal docs searchable from chat, with answers that point to the page they came from.
Set it up in Claude, Cursor or VS Code for your team, with a one-page runbook.
you_get: A SPEC.md that lists every tool with its inputs and outputs
Local stdio, or a hosted URL with OAuth

services.name: Care plan
services.short: Keep a listed server listed when the spec or a store policy changes.
scope: McpStamp Check runs on your endpoint every day. You get an alert when the score drops.
We track MCP spec changes and store policy changes, and update your server.
We re-submit your listings when a store asks for it.
you_get: A daily check with an alert
Spec and policy updates as commits

steps.title: Run the free check
steps.text: Paste your server URL into McpStamp Check. You get a score from 0 to 100 and the store blockers.

steps.title: Pay by card
steps.text: The audit is paid in full. Launch and custom work start with a deposit.

steps.title: We work in your repo
steps.text: You see each commit. We need your server URL and repo access.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: You own the code. We walk your team through it once.

faq.q: Does the deposit count toward the price?
faq.a: Yes. For Store Launch, you pay $1,500 now and $3,400 at handover. For a custom server, the $900 deposit comes off the fixed quote.

faq.q: Can you promise the stores will accept my server?
faq.a: No one can. Anthropic, OpenAI and Google review each listing themselves. We fix every blocker we find and answer reviewer questions while the job runs.
Not on this page. We'd rather show work you can check. The merged pull requests and the MCP Registry listings above are public.

faq.q: Can you work with our private data?
faq.a: We can build against a sample or a test account, so your real data never has to leave your side.
